summary: Official UP BhuNaksha establishes a Chandausi local cadastral map route and returned a safe native parcel identity plus bbox, but the anonymous full-geometry route returned 401. No GeoJSON sample is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Hindi discovery queries and actual first-party URLs are recorded in city-9045-chandausi.json.
requestOutcomes: The official SPA, current JS bundle, district/tehsil/village hierarchy, village extent, and anonymous hit-test were available over TLS-verified public requests. The full plot route required authorization. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS disablement, or unsafe property lookup was used.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [28.4524308208314, 78.7816613884015] and population fields were preserved; the point was not shifted to force a hit.
The hit-test point was a bounded sample within the returned village extent, not the WUP point; no exact-point hit/miss inference was made.
A single village extent and hit-test do not establish Chandausi municipal or citywide parcel coverage.
The public response contained a native ID and bbox but no full parcel polygon; no synthetic identity or geometry was created.
Timeout, login wall, map extent miss, unavailable UI, or protected geometry is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, personal, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is research evidence only and does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter.
safeFieldAllowlist: full parcel polygon geometry if returned
compositeKeyProvenance: The public hit-test returned bhucode 20500722220477 plus id BAxh6KpETF6Gzb1Ay3y_lQ and kide 150@1434. These are recorded as source response fields, not synthesized.
crs: EPSG:32644 for the village extent and hit-test bbox; no polygon CRS response obtained.
geometryQuality: not evaluated; no polygon geometry retrieved
